package.name: dummy_vc_moveit_config
package.description:
MoveIt 2 configuration for the Dummy arm, generated from dummy2_urdf.
Written by hand in the shape the MoveIt Setup Assistant produces, so it can be opened in the assistant later without being rewritten. The reason for writing it rather than clicking through the assistant: every value here depends on measurements made earlier in this project (joint travel, the base_link -> gripper_tcp chain, the gripper's lack of actuation), and those are easier to get right and to review in text.
